prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for most kinds of changes because almost all categories have only 1 test so far.
home, new_flow changes did not work, showing a consistent negative impact across 2 tests (-2.5% average after noise correction).
finish, new_screen and choose_path, hint changes worked and won their tests, though evidence for these categories remains thin with only 1 test each.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Deferred Flow: Reorder the onboarding flow so account sign-in happens after pet selection and adoption certificate generation. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9%. Allowing users to choose and adopt their pet before signing in builds commitment and improves sign-in motivation.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Stage Layout for Path Selection: Redesign the choose path screen into a stage layout with interactive visual path cards. (why: The choose_path step has a very high mean duration (514s), indicating users struggle to evaluate options on the current layout.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Screen: Insert a dedicated interactive desktop controls checklist screen right after home intro. (why: Support mail highlighted multiple tickets where users were confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup, and finish + new_screen changes previously succeeded.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Two-Column Pet Customization Layout: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a two-column layout featuring a live preview of the pet alongside options. (why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point (60.9% conversion) and support reported emails about custom pets looking wrong or failing.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Selection Hint: Display a hint on the choose path screen letting users know they can change their companion style later in settings. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s to complete, suggesting decision anxiety, and previous lessons show choose_path hint tests won.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Readiness Progress Display: Show an explicit progress bar and estimated time remaining during the desktop pet launch waiting screen. (why: The home waiting step has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, while support reported issues with pets not displaying or app stalling.)
6: [home, notification] Background Setup Desktop Notification Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts when the desktop pet generation finishes in the background. (why: High mean completion time (2336s) indicates users switch away during waiting; notification alerts bring them back when ready.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync and Pet Recovery Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in saves their pet and prevents reset. (why: Support mail received 8 tickets regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Shortcut Controls Tip: Update home_intro text and hint to explain hotkeys for summoning and hiding the pet on desktop. (why: Support receives user complaints about not knowing how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
